$comment: Merch print files only (no mockups). Items, trim sizes, bleed, safe areas and methods are common vendor conventions (the same list the context-ds and spyglass-ds engines use); confirm each against the print vendor's template before ordering. Layers are in inches from the trim. Only the approved lockup and mark (brand/logo, the name in Gilroy), the brand grounds and inks (image.json grounds), the website contours and the illustration skill's wireframe scenes are used. The sticker is cut along the brand's cut corner, not a rounded rectangle. The brand defines no clear-space or minimum-size rule, so none is applied.

headline.text: Physical world context for AI agents

on-light.note: No ground: the art alone in Forest and the bone wireframe tones, for light garments and stock.

on-dark.note: No ground: the art alone in Bone and the dark-ground wireframe tones, for dark garments and stock.

bone.note: The Bone ground printed to the bleed.

green.note: The Forest ground printed to the bleed.

brown.note: The Earth ground printed to the bleed.

black.note: The black ground printed to the bleed.

items.name: Cap front panel
items.source: Common front embroidery area on a structured six-panel cap: 4 by 1.75 in. Thread, so one color per file and no bleed.

items.name: T-shirt front
items.source: Common adult tee front print area: 12 by 16 in (DTG standard). Garments are not trimmed, so no bleed; keep art inside the safe area.

items.name: T-shirt back
items.source: Common adult tee back print area: 12 by 16 in. No bleed.

items.name: Hoodie front
items.source: Pullover hoodie front, above the pouch pocket: 12 by 10 in is a common area (vendors range from 11.5 by 11.5 to 12 by 12 in). No bleed.

items.name: Tote bag
items.source: Print area on a standard 15 by 16 in canvas tote: 12 by 14 in is common. No bleed.

items.name: Mug wrap (11 oz)
items.source: 11 oz mug wrap: 9 by 3.5 in is a common print area (vendors range from 8.5 to 9.5 in wide), with 0.125 in bleed for the full wrap. The handle sits at the left and right edges, so the art stays in the two halves.

items.name: Die-cut sticker
items.source: Die-cut sticker 3 by 1.75 in, cut along the brand's cut corner (a CutContour path in the SVG, a spot line the cutter reads; it is not printed), with 0.125 in bleed.

items.name: Poster
items.source: Standard 18 by 24 in poster with 0.125 in bleed on every side and a 0.5 in safe margin.

items.name: Socks (leg panel)
items.source: Crew sock leg panel, one side: 3.5 by 7 in is a common sublimation area (print twice for a pair, or mirror for the outside faces); 0.125 in bleed.
